summary: Creating a HubSpot OAuth app is free and self-serve, but new apps are built as CLI-deployed projects (app-hsmeta.json), not by clicking through a web form. Testing in a developer test account takes under an hour; going to other customers without a listing is capped at 25 installs (marketplace distribution, unverified-app warning) or 10 allowlisted accounts (private distribution). A Marketplace listing needs 3 active installs from unaffiliated accounts plus a manual review (10 business days for first feedback, up to 60 days overall), and AI connectors must be built as user-level apps, which cannot be retrofitted.

evidence.quote: Composio-managed OAuth available? Yes

composio.whenYouNeedYourOwn: Use your own HubSpot app when you want your own app name and logo on the HubSpot consent screen, need to control scopes or user-level access, or plan to list in the HubSpot Marketplace, which requires that API calls use the app ID tied to your listing. Note: Composio's managed HubSpot app is itself awaiting HubSpot approval, so users see a "Connecting an unverified app" warning.

artifacts.title: app-hsmeta.json for a Composio-connected HubSpot app (draft)
artifacts.content:
Put this at `src/app/app-hsmeta.json` in the project created by `hs project create`. Replace the redirect URL with Composio's exact callback URL and keep `requiredScopes` identical to the scopes in your Composio auth config.

```json
{
  "uid": "my_agent_hubspot_app",
  "type": "app",
  "config": {
    "name": "My Agent for HubSpot CRM",
    "description": "Lets My Agent read and update HubSpot contacts, companies and deals on your behalf.",
    "distribution": "marketplace",
    "isUserLevel": false,
    "auth": {
      "type": "oauth",
      "redirectUrls": ["<COMPOSIO_CALLBACK_URL>"],
      "requiredScopes": [
        "oauth",
        "crm.objects.contacts.read",
        "crm.objects.contacts.write",
        "crm.objects.companies.read",
        "crm.objects.deals.read",
        "crm.objects.owners.read"
      ],
      "optionalScopes": ["crm.objects.custom.read"],
      "conditionallyRequiredScopes": []
    },
    "permittedUrls": { "fetch": ["https://api.hubapi.com"], "iframe": [], "img": [] },
    "support": {
      "supportEmail": "support@example.com",
      "documentationUrl": "https://example.com/docs/hubspot",
      "supportUrl": "https://example.com/support"
    }
  }
}
```

Notes:
- Set `isUserLevel: true` (and `platformVersion: "2026.09"` in hsproject.json) if you will list as an AI connector; it cannot be changed on an existing account-level app.
- Do not use the name "HubSpot" or "Hub" combined with your app name if you plan to list (brand rules); "for HubSpot CRM" phrasing should be checked against the Branding Guidelines.
- If Composio does not send `oauth` in its scope list, remove it here so required scopes match exactly.

artifacts.title: Marketplace listing copy and shared-data table (draft)
artifacts.content:
**Tagline:** Let an AI assistant keep your HubSpot CRM up to date.

**App overview:** <Product> connects to HubSpot so your team can ask questions about contacts, companies and deals in plain language and have the assistant log updates back to the CRM. It solves stale CRM data and manual lookups. Install it to <outcome>.

**Install experience:** Seamless install, Install Button URL = the Composio redirect URL registered in the app.

**Shared data** (must match scopes):

| HubSpot object | App object | Direction |
|---|---|---|
| Contacts | People | Bi-directional (read + write scopes) |
| Companies | Accounts | HubSpot to app (read only) |
| Deals | Opportunities | HubSpot to app (read only) |
| Users/Owners | Team members | HubSpot to app (read only) |

**Testing info:** Provide a reviewer login for <Product>, steps to connect a HubSpot test account, and 3 example prompts that exercise each scope.

**Support info:** support email, support languages, setup docs URL (HubSpot-specific), ToS URL, Privacy Policy URL (all public, under 250 characters, crawlable by HubSpot Crawler).

**Pricing:** only plans that include the HubSpot integration; must match your public pricing page.

artifacts.title: Customer install note for the unverified-app warning (draft)
artifacts.content:
**Connecting HubSpot to <Product>**

1. Click **Connect HubSpot** in <Product>. You'll be sent to HubSpot.
2. Choose the HubSpot account to connect. You need to be a Super admin, or have the *HubSpot Marketplace access* permission plus access to contacts, companies and deals.
3. Review the permissions and click **Connect app**.
4. Because <Product> isn't listed on the HubSpot Marketplace yet, HubSpot shows an *unverified app* warning. Check that the app name and domain match <Product>, type **I accept the risk**, and click **Connect**.
5. You'll return to <Product> and the connection will show as active.

You can remove access anytime under HubSpot Settings > Connected apps.
